answer: Sybil resistance starts with cost that cannot be faked. An agent economy can bind every identity to a scarce, verifiable resource, whether stake, compute, or a reputation history that decays when idle, so a thousand clones buy nothing. Like an atlas that maps every claimed seat, the ledger re-walks each path before granting weight. Reputation should bloom slowly, a lotus opening only after real work, then fade like footprints on a dune once the work stops.
